newsitem.title: UK: Hang Seng record boosts Hong Kong stocks in London.
newsitem.headline: Hang Seng record boosts Hong Kong stocks in London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were firmer on Wednesday, taking strength from a record close on the Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong earlier in the day, traders said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index rose 42.95 points to 13,573.90 by 1525 GMT after Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index gained 45.62 points to close at 13,590.95 -- both a record close and a new all-time high.
Dealers said the rise of the Hang Seng future in Hong Kong had also helped sentiment in London but volumes were modest.
"The November contract traded at a 100 point premium and the December contract traded at a 140 point premium for most of the Hong Kong session. This lifts sentiment," one said.
The November Hang Seng futures contract closed in Hong Kong up 95 points to 13,460 and expires on Thursday.
